facts.fact: The World Bank report says the National Social Safety Net Program-Scale Up payment mechanism is fully digital, with all cash transfers going directly to verified, biometrically backed beneficiary-owned accounts, 100 percent of households as of July 2025.
facts.system: National Social Safety Net Program-Scale Up payment delivery mechanism

facts.fact: The World Bank report says shock-responsive cash transfer households from the Social Registers are enrolled into the payment system, with about 5.9 million households having received transfers by July 2025.
facts.system: National Social Safety Net Program-Scale Up payment system

systems.system: National Social Safety Net Program-Scale Up payment system
